deviations.description: Phase 3's own verification criteria name 'bash verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4' as its covering check
deviations.reason: Ran it: gate 4 (task-reference lint) passes; gate 3 (doc-lint) reports 5 FAIL findings. Investigated each: (1)(2) deployed script content drift for git-commit-scoped.sh and its test -- expected, since the source-store edits from Phases 1-2 have not yet been synced to .claude/ (deploy-headless.sh runs in Phase 6, not per-phase). (3) 'script file on disk NOT in provides.scripts: context-reachability.sh' -- confirmed via git log/git status this is sibling task 251's own uncommitted in-flight work (created by its own phase-1 commit, currently modified), not this task's. (4)(5) Rule R line-count mismatches for return-metadata-file.md and git-staging-scope.md -- caused by this phase's own edits growing those files; the remedy script (generate-context-line-counts.sh --write) refuses to run against the source-store tree directly ('must run from a deployed scripts/ tree') and is normally invoked automatically by deploy-headless.sh before every deploy. Deferred all five to Phase 6's redeploy + full verify-deploy.sh rather than hand-patching index-entries.json now against a tree that will be regenerated anyway.
